mapper.select: SELECT eo.id, eo.no, eo.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userName, eo.category_id AS categoryId, ec.name AS categoryName, eo.goods_id AS goodsId, eo.goods_name AS goodsName, eo.cost_point AS costPoint, eo.pay_status AS payStatus, eo.pay_time AS payTime, eo.ship_time AS shipTime, eo.logistics_info AS logisticsInfo, eo.archive_time AS archiveTime, eo.reserve1, eo.reserve2, eo.creator, eo.create_time AS createTime, eo.update_time AS updateTime FROM exchange_order eo LEFT JOIN user_info u ON eo.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN exchange_category ec ON eo.category_id = ec.id AND ec.deleted = 0 WHERE eo.id = #{id} AND eo.deleted = 0
